title: LADA Blue Wings vs Shaved Ice: Tiger's Blood, Oct 18
notes: Home game at Snoqualmie A: we wore white and had the left bench. The video came as 3438x1374, so fetch scaled it up to the rink's usual 3840x1536. It is a recording of LiveBarn's player, with LiveBarn's score panel in the top-left corner and its timeline bar along the bottom, both outside the ice.

Periods from the arena scoreboard (we were HOME) and the video: 0:07-18:06, 19:42-37:46 and 39:29-67:48 of the video. Each ran to 0.0, followed by a 1:00 intermission countdown on the board. The empty-ice proposal merged the 1st and 2nd into one period and had every net backwards. The clock ran through stoppages in the 1st and 2nd and stopped at whistles in the 3rd; the video reaches the final horn.

Goals from SportNinja's game sheet, each confirmed on the video and against the board: Belousenko #11 (assist Horokh #77) at 24:02 of the video (2nd period, clock 13:41) and Skitsko #16 (assist Belousenko #11) at 50:12, at 4-on-4 (3rd period; the board's clock stopped at 10:29, the sheet says 10:26). Shots 19-33 from the board's shots-on-goal counter, which matches the game sheet in every period.

Penalties: Skitsko #16, hooking at 14:06 of the video (1st period, clock 4:01; the sheet has 3:22). The board ran 3:00 for it, and the kill lasted until 17:44. Dukhno #50, roughing at 49:02 (3rd period, clock 10:52), killed until 54:00, at 4-on-4 at first with their #18 in the box. Shipachev #88, hooking at 61:46 (3rd period, clock 3:36): the board posted 88 2:00 and then cleared it, because Shaved Ice got a penalty shot instead. Paplinski stopped it with his pad at 62:42. The game sheet still lists the hooking as a 2-minute minor, but it wasn't served. All our skaters were at the bench for the penalty shot, so nobody of ours is on the ice from 62:04 to 62:45 (the new "ps" span in periods.json). Shaved Ice's three slashing minors (Freda #8, Vazquez Rivas #18 twice) and a too-many-men bench minor gave us power plays.
Played: the 11 skaters of LADA's lineup, with sub goalie Paplinski #0. Didn't play: Zhuk #2, Ilinskaya #3, Potepalov #15, Tverskoy #44, Semenov #54, Antonov #95 and the subs.

Checked by hand: the lineup check flagged 9 stretches. Four were a skater with no label or a lost track. Fixed with P3 rows R1 (Horokh #77, the fifth starter of the 3rd), R160 (Trunov #35, during Dukhno's kill after the 2-0 goal), R374 and R377 (Charnysh #36 and Trunov #35 at the horn), plus periods.json entries: "on" for Charnysh #36 at 59:33-60:28 and 66:25-67:38, and "off" for Skitsko #16 from 66:21. Two 17-18 s stretches in the 1st-period kill are left: line-change overlaps at the bench.

highlights.note: 1st period, clock 4:01: hooking from behind at our blue line; 3:00 on the board
2nd period, clock 13:41: Belousenko's wrist shot from the high slot, 1-0
3rd period, clock 10:52: roughing, a wrestle at their net; 4-on-4 with their #18 in the box
3rd period, clock 10:29: Skitsko drives the left side off Belousenko's pass and jams it in at 4-on-4, 2-0
3rd period, clock 3:36: hooking in a race for a loose puck to our net; a penalty shot instead of a minor
